# `{ojs} heading_b5` {#b5}

*Recent state of the three ocean drivers. ENSO is the signal to act on; the IOD leads the OND short
rains; the Western-V is a partly-independent control on the MAM long rains.*

```{ojs}
recent = drivers.filter((d) => d.year >= 2015)
```

```{ojs}
driversChart = Plot.plot({
  height: 380, width: 900, marginLeft: 45, color: {legend: true}, y: {label: "index / z"},
  marks: [
    Plot.lineY(recent.filter(d => d.nino34_anom_noaa != null),
      {x: d => new Date(d.date), y: "nino34_anom_noaa", stroke: () => "Niño 3.4 (°C)"}),
    Plot.lineY(recent.filter(d => d.dmi_hadisst != null || d.dmi_ersst != null),
      {x: d => new Date(d.date), y: d => d.dmi_hadisst ?? d.dmi_ersst, stroke: () => "IOD (DMI)"}),
    Plot.lineY(recent.filter(d => d.wnp_std_mam != null),
      {x: d => new Date(d.date), y: "wnp_std_mam", stroke: () => "Western-V (WNP z)"}),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
html`<div class="plot-footer-row">${chartDownloadButton(driversChart, {
  filename: "enso_driver_indices_recent",
  data: recent,
})}</div>`
```

# `{ojs} heading_methods` {#methods}

Drivers: NOAA ONI / Niño 3.4 + HadISST DMI + Western-V/WNP from ERSSTv5 (Funk et al. 2018 boxes;
Niño 3.4 validated r=0.998 vs NOAA, WNP reproduces Funk's post-1997 MAM sign). Rainfall: CHIRPS v3
(Atlas hub). Production: FAOStat + KNBS (dual-engine) + AFA. GESI: KNBS gender sheets (dual-engine +
47-way Kenya-consensus). Impacts: FEWS IPC + ACLED + FEWS market prices + ReliefWeb. Full catalog:
`_master/DATA_CATALOG.md` (D409 project store). Scaffold — blocks 1–4 porting from the standalone.

```{ojs}
// Dedicated DuckDB client for the driver-indices parquet (per-plot
// client convention — DuckDB-WASM serialises queries within a
// connection, so each plot's parquet gets its own client).
// NOTE: FileAttachment(...).parquet() does NOT exist in Quarto's OJS
// stdlib — parquet must be read through DuckDBClient.
dbDrivers = DuckDBClient.of({
  driver_indices: FileAttachment("/data/KE-enso-explorer/driver_indices.parquet"),
})

drivers = dbDrivers.query(`SELECT * FROM driver_indices ORDER BY date`)
```

:::
